fields.Name: Engagement Lead
fields.Description: Runs a professional services engagement and attests its progress (MJ.BizApps.Orders.Progress.Attest). Holds no price override grant.

fields.Name: Account Director
fields.Description: Books the order and may type any unit price on it (MJ.BizApps.Orders.Price.OverrideAny, which implies OverrideList). Does not hold progress attestation.

fields.Name: Orders Revenue Supervisor
fields.Description: Supervises percentage-of-completion revenue in BizApps Orders. Holds MJ.BizApps.Orders.Progress.Supersede, which replaces a posted progress observation through Orders.RecordProgress — the recovery path for a mistyped measurement date or percent. Additive: a supersede is itself an attestation, so assign it alongside Engagement Lead, and only to the people who sign off project revenue.
